name: a-stock-earnings-season
description: Scans A-share earnings forecasts and periodic reports, decomposes single-quarter growth and profit quality, and screens the companies whose results are genuinely strong.

displayDescription.en: Scans every A-share earnings forecast and periodic report in the season, splits out single-quarter growth, non-recurring items and cash backing, and screens the companies whose results are genuinely strong into an interactive HTML report.
displayDescription.zh: 扫描A股业绩预告与季报，拆单季增速、扣非与现金流含金量，筛出业绩真正优秀的公司并出可视化报告
